data.name: The Playhouse
data.detailed_description:
Something was never right about The Playhouse.

Years ago, the once-famous entertainment center was full of laughter, colorful mascots, and families enjoying its attractions. But after a series of mysterious events, The Playhouse suddenly shut down and faded into obscurity. The building has remained abandoned ever since.

Your friend once worked there long ago. After disappearing without explanation, you eventually discover an old company file listing him as the third CEO of The Playhouse. Confused and concerned, you decide to investigate the abandoned building yourself.

But when you finally step inside, it quickly becomes clear that something is terribly wrong.

The halls are silent. The mascots are no longer friendly.
And whatever happened here… is still waiting.

Explore the dark remains of The Playhouse, uncover hidden secrets, and piece together the truth behind your friend's disappearance. As you search deeper into the facility, you’ll encounter strange puzzles, unsettling environments, and terrifying mascots that seem to have a life of their own.

Will you uncover the truth behind The Playhouse, or become just another missing visitor?

data.short_description: Your friend worked a long time ago at the famous Playhouse that shut down years ago. He goes missing for quite some time and you finally find him in a file that states him as the 3rd CEO of The Playhouse. Curious you go search for him in The Playhouse but when you come in it is already too late...
